name: Shiodome
tagline: Toranomon in 8 minutes and Tokyo in 9 minutes. Served by 2 lines. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000.
summary: The station is in Minato City, where the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation and Yurikamome run 2 lines between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 15 minutes to Otemachi, 19 minutes to Shinjuku, 21 minutes to Shibuya and 13 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. The station stands 3.5 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 2.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 3.5 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 1.5 m to 3.6 m, a difference of 2.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 5 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is 0.5 to 3 m. For storm surge, 7 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is about average for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 9 clinics and 7 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 十仁病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 港勤労者医療協会芝病院, about 12 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 2 lines serve the station: Toei Oedo Line and Yurikamome. The lines are split between operators (the Tokyo Metropolitan Bureau of Transportation runs 1 line and Yurikamome runs 1 line), so when one line stops you can change to a line run by a different company.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. Yurikamome runs at 92% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch of the line is 汐留→竹芝, which includes this station. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 1K ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. 1LDK ¥300,000 to ¥310,000 and 2LDK ¥430,000 to ¥440,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.
drivers: Age and construction of the building
Whether it faces a main road or the railway
Whether it sits at the top or the bottom of a slope

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥150,000 to ¥160,000. For 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Shimbashi is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Shiodome is ahead on how easy the shopping is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shiodome. It reaches Otemachi 6 minutes sooner than Shiodome.

neighbours.lead: Shiodome is ahead on the number of lines and how close the centre is.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Shiodome. It takes 6 minutes longer to reach Otemachi than Shiodome. One-room rents run about ¥10,000 lower.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
notFor: People who want to hold the rent down
noiseSources: The 首都高速都心環状線 viaduct runs just outside the station. It is an expressway, so traffic is audible day and night
新橋日の出ふ頭線 (2 lanes each way) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 5 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: 2 lines serve the station, and the choice of connections is wider than at most stations in the 23 wards.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the high side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the high side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
